# Cookie mechanism is broken after refactoring for 9.0.0

After refactoring the cookie mechanism for 9.0.0, it's broken and no longer works. Several modules depend on it, and the ps_googleanalytics also uses it for example.

`Context::getContext()->cookie->testmessage = 'something in the cookie';` no longer works if not followed by a redirect.

Use following module to reproduce: [cookietest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18887842/cookietest.zip)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/46dcbd47-6469-4f06-bf91-db833290683e)

8.1.7:
- Add cookie and redirect - works and saves the cookie, redirects to the same page ✅
- Add cookie - works and saves the cookie, redirects to the same page ✅
- Remove cookie and redirect - works and saves the cookie, redirects to the same page ✅
- Remove cookie - works and saves the cookie, redirects to the same page ✅

9.0.0:
- Add cookie and redirect - works and saves the cookie, redirects to the same page ✅
- Add cookie - redirects to the same page, but cookie is not saved 🔴 
- Remove cookie and redirect - works and saves the cookie, redirects to the same page ✅
- Remove cookie - redirects to the same page, but cookie is not saved 🔴

## Attendu
Context::getContext()->cookie->testmessage = 'something in the cookie';
and
unset(Context::getContext()->cookie->testmessage);
must work.

Ping @jolelievre @tleon
